GM Daniel Naroditsky. 119 studies. One of chess's top educators; opening analysis including Danish Gambit and Englund Gambit refutation (both Lichess staff picks). Charlotte, NC.

FM Alexander Longson. 511 studies. Director of UK Chess Challenge; FIDE 2329. Annotated WC matches (Nepo-Ding), positional masterpieces, junior game collections, endgame material. Manchester, England.
IM & FIDE Trainer Hemant Sharma. 385 studies. India U-25 Champion 2010; FIDE 2356. Endgame studies, training exercises, and compositions. New Delhi, India.
No title. 115 studies. Deep opening theory specialist based in Germany. Extensive Sicilian variant coverage (Dragon, Sveshnikov, Najdorf, Kan), Caro-Kann/Panov Attack, and numerous other systems.
CM Tryfon Gavriel. 117 studies. YouTube chess educator with 115k+ subscribers; webmaster of chessworld.net. Game annotations, tournament coverage including Carlsen-Karjakin WC match. London, UK.

FM Jens Hirneise. 94 studies. Publisher of Rochade Europa chess magazine; organizer of Lichess Bundesliga and Rapid League. Monthly Game of the Month annotations, GM interviews. Lichess moderator and content team.
IM Lasse Østebø Løvik. 70 studies. Norwegian IM; Lichess Bullet rating ~2851. Annotated Norway Chess 2017, Candidates 2020 games, and other elite tournament coverage. Note: account semi-active.
No title. 47 studies. Author of the comprehensive 'Cool Lichess Studies List' curated blog. Racing Kings World Champion 2021. Coaches beginners; 125k+ games played on Lichess.
GM Moulthun Ly. 24 studies. Australian GM; Lichess Bullet 3001. Chess writer, YouTuber, and coach. Opening analysis including Smith-Morra Gambit. Brisbane, Australia.
IM Shamil Arslanov. Multiple studies. Russian chess school coach; FIDE 2410. Interactive puzzles, zugzwang exercises, Evans Gambit tactics, Max Lange Attack analysis. Moscow, Russia.

GM Noel Studer. 8 studies. Swiss GM and chess improvement blogger. Beginner-focused content: opening principles, checkmate patterns, beginner openings for White and Black. Popular blog posts with 10k+ views.
GM Dmitry Gordievsky. 6 studies. Peak FIDE 2653; 5,300+ coaching hours on Lichess. Top-GM Blitz Repertoire analysis series (Hikaru, Naroditsky, Bortnyk, Minh Le). Moscow, Russia.

NM. 12 studies. Lichess developer and #1-ranked Crazyhouse player (rating 2772). Chess960 specialist, variant content creator, curated studies blog author. Organizer of Crazyhouse World Championship 2025.

FM Thijs Laarhoven. 4 studies. Dutch FM; Lichess Blitz 2604. Creator of the beloved 'Beautiful Chess Studies' series (1,200+ likes) and 'Beautiful Checkmate Puzzles'. Also built Lichess knockout tournament tools.

No title. ~15+ studies. Prolific opening study creator; frequent co-author with The_Inverse_Tangent. Notable works: 'Tactical Brilliancies From Master Games' (677 likes), Bishop's Opening repertoire, Rousseau Gambit, compositions collections.
No title. ~8+ studies. Opening studies (Rosentreter Gambit, Traxler refutation, French Defense 3.Bd3) and tournament puzzle compilations (Tata Steel 2025, Norway Chess 2025). Active in 2025.
GM David Navara. 3 studies. Czech super-GM; FIDE 2628, Lichess Blitz 2854 (Rank 32). Annotated Nepo-Ding WC match; Chess960 content. Author of 'My Chess World' and 'Lessons on Uncompromising Play'.
NM. 3 studies. USCF 2300; Crazyhouse World Champion 2022. Popular instructional studies: 'Learn The London System' (688 likes), 'Learn To Think Like A Grandmaster' (532 likes). New York City.
CM Alexandre Aumont. 3 studies. French chess coach; FIDE 2232. Opening mastery series (Sicilian Dragon), pawn breaks in the attack. Streams at alexandrechecs.com.
GM Nijat Abasov. 1 study. Candidates 2024 participant; FIDE Senior Trainer; FIDE 2679. Single high-impact study: 'FIDE World Championship 2021 Annotated' (1,776 likes). Baku, Azerbaijan.
